notes: *may not* is written as two words, so rule 35 splits it: יָכֹל takes *may* and לֹא takes *not*, rather than sharing an indivisible *cannot*.
לָשׁוּב לְקַחְתָּהּ recast as *take her again*: שׁוּב holds *again* and both infinitive prepositions go unrepresented (rules 40, 52).
*that is abomination* gives the construction-supplied copula to the predicate noun and *that* to the pronoun הִוא (rules 18, 20).
